roadmap.title: Tutorial
roadmap.description: Finish the tutorial hideout and duel.

roadmap.title: Early campaign
roadmap.description: Take early-window and easy goals: infiltrate a hostile town early, explore, trade, build income.

roadmap.title: Mid campaign
roadmap.description: Win battles, take fiefs, and found a kingdom.
achievementRefs: What have the Romans ever done for us

roadmap.title: Late campaign
roadmap.description: Long grinds, conquest, and the banner path choice.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer
roadmap.description: Finish the online achievements, ideally with friends.
achievementRefs: Ride it like you stole it

achievements.description: Defeat a force that has 500 more troops than you
achievements.summary: Beat an enemy force that outnumbers your side by at least 500 troops.

steps.text: Fight an army that outnumbers your side by at least 500 troops, alone or as part of an outnumbered army.
Win the battle.

achievements.description: First born child.
achievements.summary: Have your first child born.

guide.context: Save by hand before the birth and reload if the child is stillborn. The Vigile perk in the Charm tree raises the chance of pregnancy by 30%. Marrying the spouse for Heartbreaker also counts.

steps.text: Enable the birth and death option when you start the campaign.
Ask an unmarried lord for a marriage with a young relative of their clan, and pay the marriage price.
Recall your spouse into your party and travel together for about 1-2 in-game weeks.
Wait for the birth message and watch the birth scene.

achievements.description: Assemble Dragon Banner of Calradia.
achievements.summary: Assemble the Dragon Banner of Calradia.

steps.text: After the tutorial, ask lords and NPCs with a golden marker about the banner until ten lords have told you the story.
Visit Istiana in @loc{Epicrotea} or Arzagos in @loc{Mannurath} when the quest points you to them.
Attack the two bandit hideouts they name and defeat each leader to take the banner pieces.
Collect every piece. The achievement unlocks when the banner is assembled.

achievements.description: Execute a lord that has executed one of your clan members.
achievements.summary: Execute a lord who executed one of your clan members.

steps.text: Keep clan members in separate parties until an enemy lord kills one.
Note which lord did it.
Capture that lord and choose to execute them.

achievements.description: Kill 10.000 other opponents in captain mode, with your troops.
achievements.summary: Kill 10,000 opponents with your troops in Captain mode.

steps.text: Join multiplayer and filter for Captain mode.
Lead your squad in matches until the Steam counter reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Have 100 butters in your inventory.
achievements.summary: Hold more than 100 butter in your inventory.

steps.text: Buy butter from towns and villages until you carry more than 100.
Wait about a day for the achievement.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy player with a boulder
achievements.summary: Drop a boulder on an opposing player and kill them.

steps.text: Join a siege match.
Pick up a boulder from a stone pile on the wall or in the gatehouse.
Drop it on an enemy to kill them.

achievements.description: Win 100 tournaments.
achievements.summary: Win 100 tournaments.

guide.context: Team formats can still be won if you are knocked out and teammates finish. A shield and one-handed weapon is a safe loadout.

steps.text: Enter every tournament you find in a town.
Win each tournament until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Score a headshot from 200 meters away.
achievements.summary: Land a headshot on a target at least 200 meters away.

guide.context: Save before the fight so you can retry the shot.

steps.text: Equip a bow or crossbow and level the matching skill.
Fight in a siege or a pirate hideout and aim at the furthest standing enemy's head.
Check the shot readout on the left; reload and retry until a headshot reads 200 meters or more.

achievements.description: Defeat 10.000 troops.
achievements.summary: Kill 10,000 troops personally.

guide.context: Troop kills by your companions and soldiers do not count.

steps.text: Fight in battles yourself and kill troops with your own hero.
Watch the Steam counter until it reaches 10,000.

achievements.description: Defeat Radagos in a duel.
achievements.summary: Defeat Radagos in a duel.

guide.context: Take the duel when Radagos offers it. Save before agreeing, since a declined duel may not come back.

steps.text: Kill the remaining defenders in the hideout.
Accept the duel Radagos offers.
Win the duel, then continue the dialogue that follows to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: Reach clan tier 6.
achievements.summary: Reach clan tier 6.

steps.text: Win battles, tournaments, and quests to earn renown.
Check the Clan menu until the clan reaches tier 6.

achievements.description: Own a workshop and a caravan at the same time.
achievements.summary: Hold a workshop and a caravan simultaneously.

guide.context: A caravan costs 15,000 denars, or 22,500 for a heavily guarded one.

steps.text: Talk to merchants in a town and buy a workshop.
Talk to merchants again to form a caravan and choose a companion or clan member as its leader.

achievements.description: Visit every settlement in the world in a game.
achievements.summary: Visit every settlement in the world.

guide.context: Towns and castles are listed below. Villages are not on the checklist. The unlock can arrive many hours after the last visit.

achievements.description: Make 1 million denars trade profit.
achievements.summary: Make 1,000,000 denars of trade profit.

guide.context: Only profit counts, not the gold you spend or earn elsewhere.

steps.text: Raise Trade so profitable goods show in green.
Buy cheap in one town and sell higher in another until the profit counter reaches 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Barbarian victory.
achievements.summary: Destroy one imperial faction on the Arzagos path.

guide.context: This path and the imperial path exclude each other. You need a second campaign for Long live the Empire!.

steps.text: After assembling the banner, return to Arzagos in @loc{Mannurath} to take the non-imperial path.
Create a non-imperial kingdom, or hand the banner to a non-imperial ruler you have joined.
Finish the quest that weakens the Empire so each imperial faction holds four major cities or fewer.
Capture cities, raid villages, beat armies, and capture lords until one imperial faction is destroyed.

achievements.description: Become the leader of the tournament board.
achievements.summary: Become the top of an arena leaderboard.

steps.text: Enter tournaments in towns and win them.
Open the arena leaderboard in a town until your name has the crown at the top.

achievements.description: Become a great grandparent.
achievements.summary: Become a great-grandparent.

guide.context: Daughters leave your clan when they marry, so aim for sons.

steps.text: Have children and raise mainly sons so the line stays in your clan.
Wait until one of your grandchildren has a child.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemy players with headshots with ranged weapons in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemy players with ranged headshots.

steps.text: Pick an archer, crossbow, or mounted archer class.
Aim at heads in any mode except Captain until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Marry the widow of a lord or lady you personally executed.
achievements.summary: Marry the widow or widower of a lord you executed yourself.

guide.context: The execution lowers the spouse's opinion of you, so build relation first.

steps.text: Stay unmarried until you personally execute a lord or lady.
Find that lord's spouse in the Encyclopedia (press @mechanic{N}).
Raise your relation with the spouse, then propose marriage.

achievements.description: Defeat an Army with your party alone.
achievements.summary: Defeat an enemy army with your party alone.

steps.text: Find an army on the map that your party can handle.
Fight it without allied parties joining.
Win and wait a couple of minutes for the unlock.

achievements.description: Capture a town on your own.
achievements.summary: Capture a town or castle on your own.

steps.text: Gather a strong enough party and leave any army.
Besiege a town or castle without allied help and capture it.

achievements.description: Execute a lord that you have -100 relations with.
achievements.summary: Execute a lord you have -100 relation with.

steps.text: Lower a lord's relation to about -100 by taking cities, raiding villages, and executing captive lords.
Capture that lord and execute them from the prisoner menu.

achievements.description: Get a kill with a melee weapon, mounted melee, ranged, mounted range, and cauch lance in one skirmish round.
achievements.summary: Get five different kinds of kills in one skirmish round.

guide.context: Kills reset when a new round starts, so all five must come in one round.

steps.text: Join a Skirmish match.
In one round, get a kill with each of these: a melee weapon on foot, a ranged weapon on foot, a melee weapon on horseback, a ranged weapon on horseback, and a couched lance.

Play Khuzait, which has both a heavy lancer and a mounted archer class. Start as the lancer for the lance and melee kills. Then play the mounted archer, or take a dead rider's horse as an archer, for the ranged kills.

achievements.description: Acquire 10000 denars a day.
achievements.summary: Reach 10,000 denars of daily income.

steps.text: Open the Clan menu and check Finance.
Raise income from fief taxes, caravans, and workshops until it shows 10,000 denars a day.

achievements.description: Kill a faction King or Queen in battle.
achievements.summary: Kill a faction ruler in battle.

steps.text: Enable the option that lets lords die in battle when you start a campaign.
Fight enemy rulers, preferably in castle sieges, and strike them in the head with slashing or piercing weapons.
Repeat until a message says the ruler died in battle.

achievements.description: Win 100 battles against enemy armies.
achievements.summary: Win 100 battles against enemy armies.

steps.text: Fight and win battles against armies, which show extra troops and an army label on the map.
Follow the Steam counter to 100.

achievements.description: Kill 500 troops with a couched weapon while on horseback.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 troops with a couched lance while on horseback.

guide.context: Normal left-click lance hits do not count.

steps.text: Pick a heavy cavalry class with a lance.
Ride fast, then press @mechanic{X} to couch the lance.
Hit enemies with it until 500 kills.

achievements.description: Obtain your first fief.
achievements.summary: Obtain your first fief.

steps.text: Swear allegiance to a kingdom.
Build influence and win the vote for a castle or city.

achievements.description: Clear a hideout.
achievements.summary: Clear a hideout.

steps.text: Fight through the tutorial hideout with your party until its defenders are all beaten.

achievements.description: Propose and win a policy.
achievements.summary: Propose a policy and win the vote.

steps.text: Join or create a kingdom.
Open the Kingdom menu, go to Policies, and spend influence to propose a policy.
Win the vote.

achievements.description: Imperial victory.
achievements.summary: Win an imperial victory on the Istiana path.

guide.context: This path and the Arzagos path exclude each other. You need a second campaign for Freedom!.

steps.text: After assembling the banner, return to Istiana in @loc{Epicrotea} to take the imperial path.
Create an imperial kingdom, or hand the banner to Lucon, Rhagaea or Garios after joining their faction.
Play on until the campaign ends in an imperial victory.

achievements.description: Increase any skill to 300.
achievements.summary: Raise any skill to 300.

steps.text: Pick one skill and spend focus points in it, up to the 5-point maximum.
Spend attribute points on its attribute when the value turns red, since only attribute points lift the cap.
Keep using the skill until it reaches 300.

achievements.description: Have your 7'th kid born.
achievements.summary: Have your seventh child born.

steps.text: Marry as early as you can and keep your spouse in your party.
Keep travelling together and save before each birth, reloading after a stillbirth, until a seventh child is born.

achievements.description: Kill 500 troops with range weapons while on horseback.
achievements.summary: Kill 500 troops with ranged weapons while on horseback.

steps.text: Pick a mounted archer class, such as Khuzait or Sturgia.
Shoot unarmoured enemies in the head from horseback until 500 kills.

achievements.description: Start your own Kingdom.
achievements.summary: Found your own kingdom.

steps.text: Reach clan tier 4, command at least 100 troops, stay independent, and hold a castle or city.
Assign a governor in the city management screen.
Talk to that governor to create the kingdom; pick starting laws and a name.

achievements.description: Assault and capture 100 fortifications.
achievements.summary: Capture 100 fortifications in assaults.

steps.text: Besiege and take towns and castles; retaking lost ones counts as well.
Continue until the count reaches 100.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies with charge damage in multiplayer.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with charge damage.

steps.text: Choose a mounted class and pick Tougher Horse.
Ride at full speed into wounded enemies to finish them with charge damage until 100.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with a successful chain attack combo.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies with chain attack combos.

steps.text: Join multiplayer, such as team deathmatch.
Start the next melee swing just before the first one ends, in a different direction.
Repeat until the chain kills reach 10.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemy players with a single mangonel shot.
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemy players with one mangonel shot.

steps.text: Play a siege match with a catapult.
Fire it at the group at the battering ram at the start.
Do this until one shot kills three players.

achievements.description: Conquer all Calradia.
achievements.summary: Conquer all of Calradia.

steps.text: Capture every town and castle from all other factions, whether in a kingdom or your own.

achievements.description: Craft a tier 6 sword.
achievements.summary: Craft a tier 6 sword.

steps.text: Smith swords repeatedly, preferring harder designs.
Take the Master Smith perk at skill 200 and Legendary Smith at 275 to improve your odds, until a tier 6 sword is made.

achievements.description: Get 1.000 in tributes in a single day.
achievements.summary: Receive 1,000 denars of tribute in a single day.

steps.text: Go to war with a kingdom and take its castles and towns, and capture its lords.
Keep captives in your dungeon rather than letting them be ransomed.
Accept the peace offer when it includes 1,000 or more denars of tribute.

achievements.description: Repel an attack on the walls.
achievements.summary: Repel an enemy attack on one of your cities or castles.

steps.text: Own a castle or city and wait for an enemy army to besiege it.
Defeat the attackers, either by defending the walls or by hitting the besieging camp.

achievements.description: Kick an enemy player off a wall to death.
achievements.summary: Kick an opposing player off a wall so the fall kills them.

steps.text: Join a siege or team deathmatch with walls.
Stand an enemy at a wall edge.
Press @mechanic{E} to kick them off.

achievements.description: Finish tutorial.
achievements.summary: Finish the tutorial.

steps.text: Clear the hideout, talk to your brother, and part ways. The achievement unlocks when the training-complete message appears on the world map.

achievements.description: Complete an issue in a hostile town.
achievements.summary: Finish a quest while inside a town of a faction hostile to you.

guide.context: Do it early: higher fame lowers your sneaking chance to 0% unless Roguery is upgraded.

steps.text: Stand next to a town of a faction hostile to your clan and sneak in.
Talk to a gang leader and take a quest you can finish at once, such as supplying a weapon or recruits.
Leave the town. The achievement unlocks on exit.

achievements.description: Become a king with 21 clans under your rule.
achievements.summary: Rule a kingdom with 21 clans.

guide.context: Save before each persuasion, since a failed attempt closes that lord to the topic. Rich, loyal clans refuse.

steps.text: Become a ruler by founding a kingdom or by being chosen as an existing one's ruler.
Persuade clan leaders of other kingdoms to join you using the dialogue and payment offers.
Make companions into new clans by gifting a city or castle.
Check the Kingdom menu's Clans list until it shows 21.

achievements.apiName: What have the Romans ever done for us
achievements.displayName: What have the Romans ever done for us?
achievements.description: Complete all projects in a settlement.
achievements.summary: Complete every project in a settlement.

steps.text: Pick a town or castle you hold.
Queue building projects and fund them with gold, with Steward perks if available, until nothing is left to build.

achievements.apiName: Ride it like you stole it
achievements.displayName: Ride it like you stole it
achievements.description: Spawning on foot, commandeer a mount and kill 5 enemy players without dying.
achievements.summary: Respawn without a horse, grab one in the match, and get 5 player kills before dying.

steps.text: Choose a class without a horse.
Take a free horse from the field.
Kill five enemies without dying.

completionOrder: What have the Romans ever done for us
Ride it like you stole it
